content: The best gift card deal we’ve spotted this year is happening Saturday, August 22nd, at Best Buy stores for one day only. In celebration of the retailer’s 60th anniversary, you can purchase a $100 Best Buy gift card for $60. The deal is only good for as long as supplies last at your local store, so you might want to plan on getting there no later than opening time to boost your chance of getting one. There are some limitations on how you can use the gift card. You can’t use them to buy other gift cards, like iTunes or Google Play credit, and they also can’t be used to buy prepaid or open-loop debit cards. However, they can be used in combination with other discounts or promotions on products from Best Buy, and any returns or cancellations you make will credit back to the gift card. We’ve found a number of deals during Best Buy’s 60th anniversary sale that you can apply that gift card to. The iPad Air M4 dropped to $649, the lowest we’ve seen since the prices went up this summer, and the AirPods Max 2 are only $429, $120 lower than their usual price. There are a variety of discounts on Windows and macOS laptops too, like this HP OmniBook X Flip 2-in-1 for $749.99, a $450 discount from the typical price.

chineseContent: 我们发现今年最好的礼品卡优惠将于 8 月 22 日星期六在百思买商店进行，仅限一天。为了庆祝该零售商成立 60 周年，您可以花费 60 美元购买一张价值 100 美元的百思买礼品卡。该优惠仅在您当地商店的供应有限时有效，因此您可能需要计划在营业时间之前到达那里，以增加获得商品的机会。礼品卡的使用方式有一些限制。您不能使用它们购买其他礼品卡，例如 iTunes 或 Google Play 积分，也不能用于购买预付卡或开环借记卡。但是，它们可以与百思买产品的其他折扣或促销活动结合使用，并且您进行的任何退货或取消都将记入礼品卡。我们在百思买 60 周年特卖期间发现了许多优惠，您可以使用该礼品卡。 iPad Air M4 跌至 649 美元，这是自今年夏天价格上涨以来的最低价，而 AirPods Max 2 仅 429 美元，比平常价格低了 120 美元。 Windows 和 macOS 笔记本电脑也有各种折扣，例如这款 HP OmniBook X Flip 二合一售价 749.99 美元，比一般价格折扣 450 美元。
